hero.title: Study Computer Science in Germany for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Unlock world-class engineering and computing education across Germany's elite TU9 technical universities with tuition-free public degree options. Indian students gain practical industry immersion in Europe's strongest industrial economy and access an 18-month post-study job seeker visa.

overview: Germany is an international powerhouse for engineering and technology education, offering Indian students exceptional Computer Science (Informatik) programs that integrate mathematical rigor with practical industrial innovation. German universities are globally recognized for excellence in software systems, embedded architectures, industrial robotics, and artificial intelligence.

Public universities and TU9 institutes of technology across Germany deliver premier English-taught Bachelor's and Master's degree programs with zero tuition fees (charging only a nominal semester administrative fee of €150–€350). Students collaborate with global industry leaders like SAP, Siemens, BMW, and Bosch on cutting-edge research, hands-on laboratory courses, and paid master's thesis projects.

International graduates in Germany benefit from highly favorable immigration and career pathways. Under German immigration law, non-EU graduates can extend their residence permit for up to 18 months to seek qualified employment (Jobseeker Visa), followed by seamless transition to an EU Blue Card and expedited settlement opportunities.
